note: Built by tools/build_orto_bdot.py on 2026-10-17T11:05:28+00:00 in 16 s from the GUGiK orthophotomap WMS sheet index https://mapy.geoportal.gov.pl/wss/service/PZGIK/ORTO/WMS/SkorowidzeWgAktualnosci (layers SkorowidzeOrtofotomapy2026, SkorowidzeOrtofotomapy2025, SkorowidzeOrtofotomapy2024, SkorowidzeOrtofotomapyStarsze from GetCapabilities; one GetFeatureInfo with all layers at the centre of every grid sheet of the bbox: PL-1992 1:10000 (36), PL-2000 1:2000 (99), PL-1992 1:5000 (120); 255 requests, 1323 distinct records, parsed by Kartograf's query_skorowidz_layer). Every colour variant of the index (RGB, CIR, B/W) is listed; Kartograf's CLI downloads only RGB (image_provider uses color=RGB), so CIR and B/W have no download_hint. Key = (year of aktualnoscRok, PL-1992/PL-2000, wielkoscPiksela label, kolor, file format). A record belongs to the area when its sheet frame overlaps the bbox by more than 1 m (overlaps_area). sheets_full/sheets_partial from the index flag calyArkuszWyeplnionyTrescia (TAK/NIE). uncovered_m2 = 1 m pixels of the bbox outside the frames (sheet_frame_2180, PL-2000 zone frames transformed to EPSG:2180) of the combination's sheets, measured by pixel centre; the whole bbox is land, no PRG land mask is applied. complete = uncovered_m2 == 0 and no partial-only sheet. full_m2 = 1 m pixels of the bbox inside the frames of sheets with a full record of the combination. sheet_records = per sheet the record --year fetches within the combination (newest full, else newest; order date, published, url) and the number of its records there; campaigns_selected = distinct campaigns of sheet_records of the sheets_full. size_bytes is null (no HEAD of image files); index_size_mb = sum of the index field rozmiarPlikuMB over the combination's files. download_hint: the orthophotomap has no pixel filter, so a hint adds --all-campaigns when the newest RGB flight of the year on a sheet has another pixel. A partial record whose footprint misses every query point would not be found (same limitation as Kartograf's sheet-centre lookup).
